summary.label: step3a-live-subset
summary.note: Fresh local server handling for five intended MAIN families; broad financial assessment handled locally. No repeated requests. A clarification is handling success, not capability implementation.

turns.text: How much have I spent on bubble tea related purchases this year?
issues: clarified instead of answering: Related purchases need explicit inclusion rules before a calculation. Which purchase-description terms or categories should count? I can propose literal rules for your review and approval. Your original request: “How much have I spent on bubble tea related purchases this year?”
turns.note: Bubble Tea is a real category, so a plain category total is also honest. A reviewed scope is equally acceptable.
turns.actualText: Related purchases need explicit inclusion rules before a calculation. Which purchase-description terms or categories should count? I can propose literal rules for your review and approval. Your original request: “How much have I spent on bubble tea related purchases this year?”

turns.text: How much did I spend on Food & Drinks and Entertainment this month?
turns.note: Two categories. Silently answering for one is the failure being tested.

turns.text: Am I doing well with my money?
turns.note: No figure answers this. It must ask what to measure rather than invent a verdict.
turns.actualText: What would you like to assess: recorded spending against a category budget, a change from a previous period, or a particular category? Please name the category and period you want. An expense ledger alone cannot establish your overall financial health. Your original request: “Am I doing well with my money?”

turns.text: What did I spend this month, and what percentage of it was Food & Drinks?
turns.note: A complete category breakdown answers both parts: the grand total and the share. Subtotals must recombine to the total exactly.
turns.actualText: I cannot combine a spending total with a separate category-percentage answer. Would you like the recorded total or a complete category breakdown? Keep the original subject, dates and other filters in your next question. Your original request: “What did I spend this month, and what percentage of it was Food & Drinks?”

turns.text: Did I spend more on Food & Drinks or Bubble Tea this month?
turns.note: Two categories in one question. A breakdown containing both is honest; narrowing to one is not.
turns.actualText: Please resubmit the full question with one category. Combining multiple categories is not supported.

turns.text: How much did I spend on Food & Drinks, Bubble Tea and Public Transport this month?
turns.note: Three categories. A reviewed scope or a breakdown is honest; a single-category total is not.
turns.actualText: Please resubmit the full question with one category. Combining multiple categories is not supported.
